verdict: Local search is holding; overdue pipeline milestones need resolution now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, combining for 429 total actions — 18 calls, 305 direction requests, and 106 website clicks — over the last 28 days. Paid channels carried zero spend and zero leads for the full window, so all measurable activity is organic. GBP momentum is mixed: Forte Precision Metals is up 8% week-over-week, while O'Hare Precision Metals dropped 38% over the same span, with search clicks across the group also sliding sharply in the final days of the period. The deeper issue is that several CRM, outreach, and web milestones — some overdue since July — remain unresolved, which is preventing the cold-email pipeline and CRM automation from going live; those workstreams are being driven to completion with October 31 as the target date. Once the contact pulls and sequence launches clear, you should see the first outreach activity reflected in next period's numbers.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all brands in the last 28 days
organic search clicks driven by O'Hare Precision Metals alone this period
week-over-week drop in O'Hare GBP actions, now under active review

watch_item.issue: Two Google Business Profile profiles — Precision Ground Bars and Precision Ground Metals — generated zero calls across hundreds of impressions this period, suggesting a contact or conversion friction problem on those listings.
watch_item.fix: Both profiles are being audited for accurate contact details and listing health, with corrections to be submitted this week.
